question: The animals or plants which can inbreed successfully must belong to the same _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**species**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Species** is the fundamental category of biological classification, ranking below a genus and consisting of related organisms capable of interbreeding.
 
• Members of the same **species** share common characteristics and can produce fertile offspring.
